draw a conclusion: After looking at the data carefully, the students drew a conclusion about why plants grow faster.
学生们仔细观察数据后,得出了植物为什么长得更快的结论。
cholera: In the nineteenth century, cholera spread quickly through cities because the water was not clean.
十九世纪,由于水源不洁,霍乱在城市中迅速蔓延。
expose…to: Doctors advised the children not to expose their skin to strong sunlight for too long.
医生建议孩子们不要让皮肤在强烈阳光下暴晒太久。
Cambridge: My cousin is studying physics at Cambridge, and she says the libraries there are wonderful.
我的表姐在剑桥大学学习物理,她说那里的图书馆棒极了。
link…to…: Scientists have linked smoking to many serious diseases, including lung cancer.
科学家已将吸烟与包括肺癌在内的许多严重疾病联系起来。
apart from: Apart from a slight headache, she felt fine after the long flight.
除了轻微的头痛,长途飞行后她感觉很好。
firework: We watched a beautiful firework light up the sky during the New Year celebration.
新年庆祝活动中,我们看到一朵美丽的烟花照亮了夜空。
co-operative: The students were very co-operative and helped the teacher clean up the classroom.
学生们非常合作,帮助老师打扫了教室。
（be）strict with…: My father is strict with me, but I know he only wants the best for me.
我父亲对我很严格,但我知道他只是希望我一切都好。
Nicolaus Copernicus: Nicolaus Copernicus was a Polish astronomer who showed that the earth moves around the sun.
尼古拉·哥白尼是波兰天文学家,他证明了地球绕着太阳转。
privately: She spoke to the teacher privately after class to ask about her exam result.
下课后她私下找老师询问了考试结果。
consist of: The medical team consists of three doctors and five nurses.
这支医疗队由三名医生和五名护士组成。
London Heathrow Airport: Their plane landed at London Heathrow Airport early in the morning after a long flight.
经过长途飞行,他们的飞机一早降落在伦敦希思罗机场。
River Avon: The town of Stratford lies on the River Avon, where boats pass by quietly.
斯特拉特福镇坐落在埃文河畔,船只静静地驶过。
River Thames: Many famous bridges cross the River Thames in the heart of London.
伦敦市中心有许多著名的桥梁横跨泰晤士河。
River Severn: The River Severn is the longest river in Britain, famous for its high tidal waves.
塞文河是英国最长的河流,以高高的潮汐浪闻名。
divide…into: The teacher divided the class into four groups for the science project.
老师把全班分成四个小组来做科学项目。
Wales: Wales is famous for its beautiful mountains and its own language, Welsh.
威尔士以美丽的山脉和它自己的语言威尔士语而闻名。
Northern Ireland: Northern Ireland is part of the United Kingdom and lies on the island of Ireland.
北爱尔兰是联合王国的一部分,位于爱尔兰岛上。
break away: The little horse managed to break away from the rope and ran across the field.
小马挣脱了绳子,跑过了田野。
break away from: He finally decided to break away from his old habits and start a healthier life.
他终于决定摆脱旧习惯,开始更健康的生活。
the Union Jack: The Union Jack combines the flags of England, Scotland and Ireland.
英国国旗融合了英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰的旗帜。
to one’s credit: To her credit, she admitted her mistake and apologized at once.
值得赞扬的是,她承认了错误并立即道歉。
roughly: The journey took roughly three hours by train, depending on the traffic.
乘火车大约需要三个小时,取决于交通状况。
Midlands: Many factories were built in the Midlands during the industrial revolution.
工业革命期间,英格兰中部地区建起了许多工厂。
Roman: The old city wall was built by Roman soldiers almost two thousand years ago.
这段古城墙是近两千年前罗马士兵修建的。
Anglo-Saxon: Many common English words came from the language of the Anglo-Saxons.
许多常见的英语单词来自盎格鲁-撒克逊人的语言。
Norman: After 1066, the Norman rulers brought French words into the English language.
1066年以后,诺曼统治者把法语词汇带进了英语。
Viking: A group of Vikings sailed across the sea and reached the northern coast.
一群维京人渡海而来,抵达了北部海岸。
take the place of: Nothing can take the place of a good night's sleep when you are tired.
累的时候,没有什么能代替一夜好眠。
break down: Our car broke down on the way to the airport, so we took a taxi.
我们的车在去机场的路上抛锚了,所以我们打了辆出租车。
St Paul’s Cathedral: Tourists climbed to the top of St Paul's Cathedral to enjoy the view of London.
游客们登上圣保罗大教堂的顶端,欣赏伦敦的景色。
Westminster Abbey: Many kings and queens of England were crowned in Westminster Abbey centuries ago.
许多英国国王和女王几个世纪前在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕。
Buckingham Palace: Crowds gathered outside Buckingham Palace to watch the changing of the guard.
人群聚集在白金汉宫外观看换岗仪式。
Greenwich: Visitors to Greenwich can stand on the famous line that divides east and west.
到格林尼治的游客可以站在划分东西半球的著名线上。
Highgate Cemetery: Highgate Cemetery lies in the north of London and attracts many visitors every year.
海格特墓地位于伦敦北部,每年吸引许多游客前来参观。
jet lag: It took him two days to get over the jet lag after flying back from America.
从美国飞回来后,他花了两天时间才倒过时差。
flashback: The film begins with a flashback to the hero's childhood in a small village.
影片以一个闪回开场,回到主人公在小村庄的童年。
be back on one’s feet: After a month of rest, the injured player was back on his feet again.
休息了一个月后,受伤的球员完全康复了。
safety belt: Remember to fasten your safety belt before the plane takes off.
记得在飞机起飞前系好安全带。
